1.11: Fixed BT still advertising when the device is powered off but still plugged in.
Fixed MIDI CC 43 and CC 44 not responding for AMP and IR switching.
Fixed clicking when switching FX2 Drive.
1.12: Updated Spring Reverb: Offers Decay, PreDelay, Crossover, Tone and Mix controls.
Expanded Duck Delay: Added Sensitivity, Depth, Attack and Release controls for finer adjustment of the ducking response.
Extended Pitch Range: Coarse adjustment now spans −24 to +24 semitones, retaining ±1-semitone Fine adjustment and improving low-note tracking.
Added CAB/IR Output Level: Independently adjust and save the cabinet simulation’s output level alongside Low Cut and High Cut.
